news.title: Caledonia Mining CEO discusses Q3 results and Blanket Mine recovery
news.summary:
Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC (AIM:CMCL, NYSE-A:CMCL, VFEX:CMCL) CEO Mark Learmonth spoke with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about the company's third-quarter 2026 results, a recovery in production at Blanket Mine in Zimbabwe and progress towards developing the Bilboes Gold Project.

Learmonth described a challenging quarter, with gold production of around 17,000 ounces falling short of expectations. However, higher gold prices, averaging more than US$4,100 per ounce, helped deliver EBITDA of just over US$28 million. Nine-month EBITDA reached approximately US$108 million, highlighting the business's strong cash generation.

He explained how delays installing compressors and modifications to the processing plant affected output, leaving around 1,100 ounces of gold trapped in the circuit. With the compressors installed and a new elution vessel commissioned, October production rebounded to just under 7,000 ounces.

Learmonth also discussed a US$150 million financing facility arranged with Zimbabwean banks to support Bilboes development and long-lead equipment purchases.

Looking ahead, he outlined plans to increase Blanket production in 2027, expand mining activity and test oxide heap-leach opportunities, alongside a 22% increase in Blanket's measured and indicated mineral resources.

news.title: Caledonia Mining CEO on securing US$150m facility to accelerate Bilboes gold project
news.summary:
Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC (AIM:CMCL, NYSE-A:CMCL, VFEX:CMCL) CEO Mark Learmonth spoke with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about a US$150 million interim financing facility for its Bilboes gold project in Zimbabwe and progress towards full project funding.

Learmonth said the facility would support procurement, early site activity and contractor payments, helping prevent delays as development advances. He described it as a key part of the company's four-pillar funding strategy, alongside gold price hedging, a convertible bond raise and traditional project financing.

The first three elements are now in place, with long-term project financing still being finalised. Learmonth said discussions with a funding consortium were progressing faster than expected, although converting internal credit approval into a drawable facility could take another three to four months.

The interim facility has been syndicated across eight Zimbabwean banks, which Learmonth said demonstrated growing lender appetite and lending capacity in the country.

With contractors already undertaking preliminary work, investors can expect further procurement activity and basic earthmoving before year-end. Learmonth stressed that keeping the project moving was vital to protecting its value.

rationale.ebit_margin: Starts at last year's EBIT margin (41.1%) and moves to the 4-year median (22.6%) over 5 years.
rationale.tax: Median effective tax rate (30.0%), kept within 15–30%.
rationale.reinvestment: Historical medians: D&A 7.9%, capex 18.9% of revenue; working capital 11.4% of revenue, so each extra $1 of sales ties up $0.11. Stock-based compensation (0.4% of revenue) is treated as a cash cost. IFRS reporters: lease payments sit in financing cash flow, so check capex covers them.
